assessments.reasoning: The Archive's m4/ax_pthread.m4 at commit 23fb4bfec24351cd6bdc74d4e08f538bcb721e99 identifies AX_PTHREAD in the synopsis and places the exception under LICENSE immediately before serial 38. The two captures cover all 23586 bytes and report the scoped digest.

The Index's pinned License exception row at bytes [640,783) admits an additional permission to a base license. The specimen expressly permits use and distribution of the identified scripts without following the GPL terms. The row reserves affected-edition claims for separate support.

challenge.method: Under pinned SCES-1.0 §§1, 3–4 and Research Protocol stage 7, tested whether the Archive grants a stand-alone license for all uses of AX_PTHREAD, or whether the exception comes from Autoconf itself. Checked the grantor, the object of each permission and the reservation immediately following it.
challenge.results: The notice attributes the exception to the respective macro copyright owner and identifies configure scripts produced by processing the macro. It expressly keeps other uses of the macro material under the GPL. The Archive publishes the specimen and Autoconf produces the output.

limitations: The specimen carries a GPL version 3 or later notice. Other Archive macros and particular generated scripts require their own applicability evidence.
The finding identifies the publisher specimen. SPDX release correspondence, byte equality and formal template matching require separate evidence.
Active is an editorial Index value. A distributor of a modified macro may choose whether to extend the exception.
reasoning: The GNU Autoconf Archive's AX_PTHREAD specimen, serial 38, contains the macro copyright owner's express permission to copy, distribute and modify configure scripts produced when Autoconf processes the macro. That permission satisfies the Index exception criterion.
